name: Nimble
description:
Your Speed is permanently doubled, but you start each of your turns with no actions. You may convert movement into actions at a rate of one half action per 10 ft, spending as much movement as you like in this way each turn.

Additionally, your jump distance and height are doubled, you can run up vertical surfaces up to ¼ your Speed as if it were flat ground, and you take no damage from falling up to ¼ your Speed if all your limbs are unrestrained. Getting up from prone costs you movement equal to half your natural Speed, not the multiplied amount granted by this ability.

These effects are suspended while you are wearing any armor of common grade or higher.

Describe your agility.

improvements.name: Hard To Pin Down
improvements.description: You may also convert movement into engagement dice at a rate of 1d4 per 10 ft.

improvements.name: Ready To Spring
improvements.description: You may spend movement equal to half your Speed to assume a ready position. If you do, for the next round, each time a creature makes a melee attack against you, skip engagement and instead roll Dexterity vs Dexterity, treating the outcome as if it were the outcome of an engagement.

improvements.name: Like The Wind
improvements.description: Your Speed is permanently tripled instead of doubled.
